ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: Empire Patch
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Version: v0.1.2
Compatibility patch: Empire Refactored colonies are classified, populated and owned under Regions and Societies territory rules, and Empire's settlement placement, reward economy and tithe respect regional ownership.
Features: - Typed binding: Empire colonies are recognised by real type and member - population from actual workers, tier from settlement level. A rename in Empire is a compile error, never a silent zero in-game. - Territory-governed placement: founding an Empire settlement inside another faction's region is refused, with the reason shown. - The player's empire resolves to Empire's own faction on the world map, labelled with Empire's configured name. - Reward and tithe economy honours the reward def's filters, tech level and quality ranges, and tithe value reflects real stack value.
Requires: Regions and Societies (either the standard or the Realistic Planets 2 edition) and Empire Refactored. No settings of its own - governance toggles live in Regions and Societies.
--- Changelog (v0.1.2) --- - RimSort install fix: the release zip now carries the mod files at its root, so RimSort no longer creates a broken nested folder on install. No gameplay changes. - New Workshop preview: series-banner design naming the patched mod, with a version stamp. - Mod author is now credited as archdukejim.
Source: https://github.com/Regions-and-societies/Empire-CP Support development: https://ko-fi.com/archdukejim
